partes.p: Now suppose John has a utility function given by $U_{J}(Y_{1}, Y_{2}) = \alpha Y_{1} + \beta Y_{2}$ where $\alpha, \beta > 0$. Characterize the set of production vectors $X$ that gives John a utility of $V > 0$. (Hint: this will be a linear equation of $X_{1}$ and $X_{2}$ in terms of $\alpha$, $\beta$, and $V$)
